    - data:
        code: "# =====================================================================\n\
          # 节点：解析SQL列表（安全校验层）\n# 作用：解析大模型输出的JSON数组，并对每条SQL做安全校验\n# =====================================================================\n\
          \nimport re\nimport json\n\n\nALLOWED_TABLE_RE = re.compile(r'^CGXTAPPMISDate_\\\
          d{4}_\\d{2}$')\n\nALLOWED_TABLES = (\n    'CGXTAPPMISNewIndicator',\n  \
          \  'BFAdminOrganization',\n    'enterprise_equipment_info',\n)\n\nDANGEROUS\
          \ = [\n    'insert ',\n    'update ',\n    'delete ',\n    'drop ',\n  \
          \  'truncate ',\n    'alter ',\n    'create ',\n    'grant ',\n    'revoke\
          \ ',\n    'copy ',\n]\n\n\ndef repair_json_quotes(text):\n    lines = text.split('\\\
          n')\n    out_lines = []\n\n    for line in lines:\n        m = re.match(\n\
          \            r'^(\\s*\"(?:sql|title)\"\\s*:\\s*\")(.*)(\"\\s*,?\\s*)$',\n\
          \            line,\n            re.DOTALL,\n        )\n\n        if m:\n\
          \            val = re.sub(r'(?<!\\\\)\"', '\\\\\"', m.group(2))\n      \
          \      out_lines.append(m.group(1) + val + m.group(3))\n        else:\n\
          \            out_lines.append(line)\n\n    return '\\n'.join(out_lines)\n\
          \n\ndef validate_sql(sql):\n    s = str(sql).strip()\n\n    if not s.lower().startswith('select'):\n\
          \        raise ValueError('SQL 不是 SELECT 查询，已拦截')\n\n    lower = s.lower()\n\
          \n    for kw in DANGEROUS:\n        if kw in lower:\n            raise ValueError('SQL\
          \ 包含危险关键字：' + kw.strip())\n\n    body = s.rstrip().rstrip(';')\n\n    if\
          \ ';' in body:\n        raise ValueError('检测到多语句 SQL，已拦截')\n\n    # 同时支持\
          \ \"MSOKFPT\".表 和 MSOKFPT.表 两种合法写法。\n    # 只在 FROM/JOIN 后解析真实表名，避免把 t.\"\
          ZBZ\" 这类列限定符误判成 schema。\n    for m in re.finditer(\n        r'(?:from|join)\\\
          s+'\n        r'(?:(?:\"?([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\"?)\\s*\\.\\s*)?'\n        r'\"\
          ?([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)',\n        s,\n        re.IGNORECASE,\n    ):\n\
          \        schema_name = m.group(1)\n        table_name = m.group(2)\n\n \
          \       if schema_name and schema_name.upper() != 'MSOKFPT':\n         \
          \   raise ValueError('引用了非白名单 schema：' + schema_name)\n\n        if table_name\
          \ in ALLOWED_TABLES:\n            continue\n\n        if ALLOWED_TABLE_RE.match(table_name):\n\
          \            continue\n\n        raise ValueError('引用了白名单外的表：' + table_name)\n\
          \n    if not re.search(r'\\blimit\\s+\\d+', s, re.IGNORECASE):\n       \
          \ s = body + ' LIMIT 1000'\n\n    return s\n\n\ndef main(input_string: str)\
          \ -> dict:\n    if not input_string or not input_string.strip():\n     \
          \   raise ValueError('输入内容为空，无法解析 JSON')\n\n    text = input_string.strip()\n\
          \n    # 去掉模型思考内容，避免思考区里的示例 JSON 干扰解析\n    text = re.sub(\n        r'<think>[\\\
          s\\S]*?</think>',\n        '',\n        text,\n        flags=re.IGNORECASE,\n\
          \    ).strip()\n\n    # 找出所有 Markdown JSON 代码块\n    fenced_blocks = re.findall(\n\
          \        r'```(?:json)?\\s*([\\s\\S]*?)\\s*```',\n        text,\n      \
          \  re.IGNORECASE,\n    )\n\n    # 优先从最后一个代码块开始尝试\n    json_candidates =\
          \ list(reversed(fenced_blocks))\n\n    # 没有代码块时，再尝试寻找 JSON 数组\n    array_matches\
          \ = re.findall(\n        r'(\\[\\s*[\\s\\S]*\\s*\\])',\n        text,\n\
          \    )\n\n    json_candidates.extend(reversed(array_matches))\n\n    parsed_json\
          \ = None\n    parse_errors = []\n\n    for candidate in json_candidates:\n\
          \        try:\n            candidate_json = json.loads(candidate.strip())\n\
          \n            if isinstance(candidate_json, list):\n                parsed_json\
          \ = candidate_json\n                break\n\n        except json.JSONDecodeError\
          \ as err:\n            parse_errors.append(str(err))\n\n    if parsed_json\
          \ is None:\n        detail = ': ' + parse_errors[-1] if parse_errors else\
          \ ''\n        raise ValueError('未找到有效的 JSON 数组' + detail)\n\n    result\
          \ = []\n\n    for index, item in enumerate(parsed_json):\n        if not\
          \ isinstance(item, dict):\n            raise ValueError('第 ' + str(index\
          \ + 1) + ' 项不是对象')\n\n        title = item.get('title')\n        sql = item.get('sql')\n\
          \n        if not title:\n            raise ValueError('第 ' + str(index +\
          \ 1) + ' 项缺少 title 字段')\n\n        if not sql:\n            raise ValueError('第\
          \ ' + str(index + 1) + ' 项缺少 sql 字段')\n\n        sql_text = validate_sql(sql)\n\
          \n        result.append({\n            'title': str(title).strip(),\n  \
          \          'sql': sql_text,\n        })\n\n    return {\n        'result':\
          \ result,\n        'count': len(result),\n        'first_title': result[0]['title']\
          \ if result else '',\n        'first_sql': result[0]['sql'] if result else\
          \ '',\n    }"
